Path of the Berserker.description: A path of untamed fury, allowing you to enter a destructive frenzy.

3.name: Frenzy
3.tldr: You can fly into a frenzy when you rage, gaining additional attacks at the cost of exhaustion.

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.tldr: You cannot be charmed or frightened while raging, and effects that caused them are suppressed.

10.name: Retaliation
10.tldr: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

14.name: Intimidating Presence
14.tldr: Use an action to terrify enemies with a terrifying presence, frightening foes within 30 feet.

Path of the Totem Warrior.description: A path incorporating animal totem spirits to guide your combat style.

3.name: Spirit Seeker
3.tldr: You can cast Speak with Animals and Beast Sense ritualistically.

3.name: Totem Spirit
3.tldr: Choose a totem animal (Bear for damage resistance, Eagle for tactical mobility, Wolf for pack combat tactics).

6.name: Aspect of the Beast
6.tldr: Gain a physical or sensory benefit inspired by your chosen animal (e.g., Bear endurance, Eagle sight, Wolf stealth).

10.name: Spirit Walker
10.tldr: You can cast the Commune with Nature spell as a ritual to learn about the surrounding land.

14.name: Totemic Attunement
14.tldr: Gain a powerful combat aura or disruptive combat capability based on your animal totem.
